name: Last One Standing
description: Three escalating rounds of absurd questions — survive the class vote, or join the jury that crowns the champion. Eliminated players never stop voting.

intro.message:
LAST ONE STANDING

Three rounds, three questions, each weirder than the last. The class votes for its favorite answer each round — the least-loved answers are OUT.

Eliminated? You become the JURY. Your vote still counts every round, and the jury crowns the champion.

r1-answer.prompt:
ROUND 1:

What is the purpose of chicken?

r2-intro.message:
The class has spoken.

Eliminated this round? Welcome to the JURY — you vote in every round from here, and the finale is yours to decide.

Survivors: it gets harder.

r2-answer.prompt:
ROUND 2:

Pitch a brand-new use for chicken that nobody in history has thought of.

r3-intro.message:
THE FINALE.

Only the finalists answer now — but the whole room votes, and only THIS round counts for the crown. Jury, this is your moment.

r3-answer.prompt:
FINAL ROUND:

Chicken has one week to change the world. What does it do?

r3-vote.question: Crown the champion — best answer wins it all!

end.message: That's Last One Standing! The chicken thanks you for your service.

recommendedFor: High-energy party round. Swap the chicken questions for anything — the escalation is the game.
